customManagers.description: The Go analyzers the check runner installs are pinned as `@vX.Y.Z` string literals inside `EnsureGoTool(...)` calls, so no built-in manager sees them. `packageName` captures the module root (`honnef.co/go/tools`) because the goproxy 404s on a package path, while `depName` keeps the full install path so `autoReplaceStringTemplate` can write the line back verbatim. The first argument is `ctx.RootDir`, an identifier, so it's matched as `[^,]+`; a regex expecting a quoted string there matches nothing.
`cargo-audit` is installed at a pinned `--version` inside the check file.
CI downloads a prebuilt `cargo-nextest` by version (`get.nexte.st/<version>/<platform>`), in all three test jobs.

packageRules.description: Non-major updates: group and auto-merge weekly

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: The check runner's pinned tools, plus the Go toolchain they're built with, land together. staticcheck has to read the export data of the Go that `.mise.toml` pins (Go 1.27.2 needed staticcheck 2026.2.2), so moving one without the other turns the `staticcheck` check red. Not automerged, for the same reason: a tool bump can re-flag tracked source.
The Go pin in `.mise.toml` rides with the check tools above.

Docker images are pinned by digest (`FROM image:tag@sha256:...`), so a tag that upstream re-points can't change what we build. Digest refreshes and non-major tag bumps land as one weekly PR that automerges on green CI; majors still wait for review.
Security fixes skip the weekly schedule and the groups, and auto-merge on green CI.
